    SELECT DISTINCT r."XCL_075" AS driver_id
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r."XCL_079" <= 10
      AND r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
),
driver_avg_fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT
        r."XCL_075" AS driver_id,
        AVG(
            CAST(SUBSTRING(r."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
            CAST(SUBSTRING(r."XCL_088", INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') + 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", '.') - INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) +

        ) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r."XCL_075"
)
SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN driver_avg_fastest_lap AS avg_lap ON d."XCL_034" = avg_lap.driver_id
INNER JOIN eligible_drivers AS ed ON d."XCL_034" = ed.driver_id
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Spanish'
